items.headline: Next-generation lung cancer pill beats current drugs on survival
items.summary: In a phase three trial published in the New England Journal of Medicine, divarasib cut the risk of death by 44 percent compared with existing KRAS-targeted drugs in previously treated lung cancer.
items.why_it_matters: KRAS mutations drive about one in eight lung cancers, and current targeted drugs help only modestly.

items.headline: Serbia's governing party concedes defeat to student-led movement after 14 years in power
items.summary: On the highest turnout since 1992, President Vucic's party conceded to the student-led list, which was projected to win a majority, with no election-day violence reported.
items.why_it_matters: A peaceful handover after more than a decade of increasingly authoritarian rule is a significant moment for democracy in Europe.
